name: Connecticut Commons
summary: Connecticut Commons is a community shopping center in Plainville, Connecticut, offering convenient access to national retailers and everyday services. Managed by SITE Centers, this well-rated property serves the greater Hartford area with practical shopping options in an accessible open-air format.
demographics: Connecticut Commons attracts a diverse suburban demographic from the Plainville and greater Hartford area, primarily serving middle-income families and working professionals aged 25-55. The trade area encompasses surrounding Connecticut communities with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $95,000, featuring a mix of homeowners and renters seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs. Visitors typically engage in routine shopping trips combining grocery runs with service-oriented errands, reflecting the practical, value-conscious preferences of central Connecticut residents.
description: Connecticut Commons is a well-established community shopping center located at 290 New Britain Avenue in Plainville, Connecticut, serving as a convenient retail destination for residents throughout the greater Hartford region. Managed by SITE Centers, a proven leader in retail property development and management, this open-air center provides a practical mix of national retailers and service providers designed to meet everyday shopping needs. The center's strategic location along New Britain Avenue ensures easy accessibility for local families and commuters seeking quality shopping options in a comfortable, suburban setting. With operating hours from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Connecticut Commons accommodates busy schedules while maintaining a welcoming atmosphere that has earned it a strong 4.3-star rating from over 2,300 customer reviews. The property exemplifies SITE Centers' commitment to creating vibrant retail environments that serve as essential community gathering places throughout Connecticut and beyond.
